summary: Grants.gov search2 (POST https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2, no key) lists NRCS opportunities with stable oppNum, title, openDate, closeDate and status. Use the grants_gov adapter with agencies USDA-NRCS. The CIG FY2026 On-Farm Trials NOFO (USDA-NRCS-NHQ-CIGOFT-26-NOFO0001447, closed 2026-07-27) is archived, so there is no live CIG call today. The only live NRCS hit is a different program (ACEP, USDA-NHQ-ACEP-26-NOFO0001456, closes 2026-11-19), which the keyword matches. The row is structured but its CIG-specific output is currently empty.

engine_requirements: None. Existing grants_gov adapter suffices. Set adapter_config.agencies to USDA-NRCS. Keyword is a real filter and matches cross-program NRCS calls, so expect non-CIG items (ACEP). For CIG-only output, the title must be checked for 'Conservation Innovation' in a later filter. The engine has no title filter today.
